components.note: 区 (qū) — near sound — 欧 is ōu; 区 also sounds out 殴 ōu and 呕 ǒu.
欠 (open mouth) — 欠 shows an open mouth, as in 吹, 歌, 欢; 欧 is mostly seen in 欧洲 Europe.
氵 (water) — 氵 is water, as in 河, 海; sand grains are tiny bits washed by water.
少 (shǎo) — near sound — 沙 is shā; 少 also sounds out 炒 chǎo and 纱 shā.
女 (woman) — 女 marks women, as in 妈, 姐, 妒; 奸 is old usage for crafty or illicit behaviour.
干 (gān) — near sound — 奸 is jiān; 干 also sounds out 肝 gān and 杆 gān.
艹 (grass, plants) — 艹 is grass and plants, as in 草, 花, 菜; 荒 is land overgrown with weeds, wasteland.
亡 (wáng) — loose hint — 荒 is huāng; 亡 also sounds out 慌 huāng, 谎 huǎng and 忙 máng.
讠 (speech) — 讠 is the simplified 言 (speech), as in 说, 话; 谬 is speech that is wrong or absurd.
翏 (liù) — near sound — 谬 is miù; 翏 also sounds out 缪 miù.
彳 (step, walk) — 彳 is the left-step radical, as in 行, 径, 德; 往 is going toward.
王 (wáng) — near sound — 往 is wǎng, same syllable with a different tone.
口 (mouth) — 口 is a mouth, as in 吃, 叫; 嘲 is mocking speech.
朝 (cháo) — same sound — 嘲 is cháo, like 朝; 朝 also sounds out 潮 cháo.
辶 (movement, road) — 辶 marks going and moving, as in 过, 进, 逃; 避 is stepping aside.
辟 (bì) — same sound — 避 is bì, like 辟; 辟 also sounds out 壁 bì and 臂 bì.
示 (altar, ritual) — 示 (礻 on the left side) marks rites and the sacred, as in 神, 礼, 福; 禁 is taboo, then forbidden.
林 (lín) — near sound — 禁 is jìn; 林 also sounds out 襟 jīn.
氵 (water) — 氵 is water, as in 河, 海; 泳 is swimming.
永 (yǒng) — same sound — 泳 is yǒng, like 永; 永 also sounds out 咏 yǒng.
犭 (animal) — 犭 is the animal radical, as in 猫, 狗, 狼; 猴 is a monkey.
侯 (hóu) — same sound — 猴 is hóu, like 侯; 侯 also sounds out 喉 hóu and 候 hòu.
女 (woman) — 女 marks women and girls, as in 妈, 姐, 妹; 娃 is a baby or girl.
圭 (guī) — loose hint — 娃 is wá; 圭 also sounds out 蛙 wā and 洼 wā.
氵 (water) — 氵 is water, as in 河, 海; 济 is to ferry across, so to help and relieve.
齐 (qí) — near sound — 济 is jì; 齐 also sounds out 剂 jì and 挤 jǐ.
艹 (grass, plants) — 艹 marks plants, as in 草, 花, 菜; 芝 is a type of plant, like sesame.
之 (zhī) — same sound — 芝 is zhī, like 之.
女 (woman) — 女 marks women, as in 妈, 姐; 妇 is a married woman.
彐 (hand) — 彐 is a hand holding a broom (the traditional 婦 had 帚), so a married woman who keeps house.
广 (building) — 广 is a building or roof, as in 店, 床, 库; 座 is a seat in a hall.
坐 (zuò) — same sound — 座 is zuò, like 坐 (to sit).
牛 (ox) — a picture of an ox's head with horns; as a radical it marks cattle, in 牺, 牲, 牧, 物.
爫 (hand) — a hand 爫 reaching down to a tree 木 to pick its fruit or leaves — to gather, as in 采访.
贝 (shell, money) — 贝 is money, as in 买, 财, 费; 购 is to buy.
勾 (gōu) — near sound — 购 is gòu; 勾 also sounds out 构 gòu and 沟 gōu.
纟 (silk, thread) — 纟 is the simplified 糸 (silk), as in 红, 给; colours come from dyed silk.
录 (lù) — same sound — 绿 is lù (lǜ in colour), like 录.
扌 (hand) — hand radical — 抽 is to pull out.
由 (yóu) — near sound — 抽 is chōu; 由 also sounds out 油 yóu and 邮 yóu.
火 (fire) — 火 is fire, as in 烧, 灯, 炒; 烟 is smoke.
因 (yīn) — near sound — 烟 is yān; 因 also sounds out 姻 yīn.
舟 (boat) — 舟 is a boat, as in 船, 般; 航 is sailing.
亢 (kàng) — near sound — 航 is háng; 亢 also sounds out 抗 kàng and 坑 kēng.
口 (mouth) — 口 is a mouth, as in 吃, 叫; 嘴 is a mouth or lips.
觜 (zuǐ) — same sound — 嘴 is zuǐ, like 觜.
钅 (metal) — 钅 is the simplified 金 (metal), as in 钱, 铁; 镇 first meant to weigh down with metal.
真 (zhēn) — near sound — 镇 is zhèn; 真 also sounds out 慎 shèn and 填 tián.
豸 (beast) — 豸 is an animal or beast radical, as in 豹; 貌 is appearance.
皃 (mào) — same sound — 貌 is mào, like 皃.
月 (flesh) — ⺼ is the body radical (月 in 脸, 脑); 胡 first meant the flesh hanging under the chin.
古 (gǔ) — near sound — 胡 is hú; 古 also sounds out 湖 hú and 糊 hú.
扌 (hand) — hand radical — 挥 is to wave or wield.
军 (jūn) — near sound — 挥 is huī; 军 also sounds out 辉 huī.
丬 (bed) — near sound — 壮 is zhuàng; 丬 also sounds out 状 zhuàng and 装 zhuāng.
士 (scholar, man) — 士 is a man, as in 战士; 壮 is a strong man.
力 (strength) — 力 is strength, as in 办, 动, 努; 劲 is energy and force.
又 (hand) — 又 here stands in for the older 巠, which gave the near sound: 经 jīng, 轻 qīng.
扌 (hand) — hand radical — 播 is scattering seed by hand, then broadcasting.
番 (fān) — near sound — 播 is bō; 番 also sounds out 翻 fān and 潘 pān.
宀 (roof) — 宀 is a roof, as in 家, 室, 安; 宗 is the ancestral hall.
示 (altar) — 示 is an altar to the ancestors — a house with an altar means clan and religion.
贝 (shell, money) — 贝 is money, as in 买, 财, 费; 货 is goods that are traded.
化 (huà) — near sound — 货 is huò; 化 also sounds out 花 huā.
宀 (roof) — 宀 is a roof, as in 家, 室; 牢 is a pen with a roof for cattle 牛, then a prison.
牛 (ox) — 牛 is cattle — kept inside for safety, so firm.
扌 (hand) — hand radical — 招 is to beckon with the hand.
召 (zhào) — near sound — 招 is zhāo; 召 also sounds out 照 zhào and 超 chāo.
山 (mountain) — 山 is a mountain, as in 岛, 岁; 崩 is a mountain collapsing.
朋 (péng) — near sound — 崩 is bēng; 朋 also sounds out 棚 péng and 绷 bēng.
氵 (water) — 氵 is water, as in 河, 海; 溃 is a river bursting its banks, so to collapse.
贵 (guì) — near sound — 溃 is kuì; 贵 also sounds out 馈 kuì.
亻 (person) — person radical — 依 is to lean on someone.
衣 (yī) — same sound — 依 is yī, like 衣.
冫 (water, ice) — 冲 is the simplified 沖: a water element (冫) beside 中, so water rushing; this form is a water cousin of 冰 and 冷.
中 (zhōng) — near sound — 冲 is chōng; 中 also sounds out 钟 zhōng.
口 (mouth) — 口 is a mouth, as in 叫, 吗; 吓 is a shout that frightens.
下 (xià) — same sound — 吓 is xià, like 下.
阝 (mound, hill) — left-side 阝 is 阜 (mound), as in 阳, 院; 陷 is falling into a pit.
臽 (xiàn) — same sound — 陷 is xiàn; 臽 also sounds out 馅 xiàn.
亻 (person) — person radical; 俄 first meant sudden, and is now mostly 俄国 Russia.
我 (wǒ) — near sound — 俄 is é; 我 also sounds out 鹅 é and 饿 è.
宀 (roof) — 宀 is a roof, as in 家, 室; 宜 is something fitting in a home.
且 (offering) — 且 is a stand for offerings (as in 祖), so 宜 is a proper offering in the house — suitable.
丹 (cinnabar) — an ancient picture of a mine with cinnabar in it; 丹 is red, as in 牡丹.
尼 (ní) — 尼 sounds out 泥 ní and 呢 ní; here it appears mostly in foreign names such as 丹尼.
酉 (wine jar) — 酉 is a fermenting jar, as in 酒, 酸, 醋; 酪 is a fermented dairy product.
各 (gè) — near sound — 酪 is lào; 各 also sounds out 络 luò and 路 lù.
阝 (mound, hill) — left-side 阝 is 阜 (mound), as in 阳, 院; 陌 is a path between fields, then unfamiliar.
百 (bǎi) — near sound — 陌 is mò.
氵 (water) — 氵 is water, as in 河, 海; 深 is deep water.
罙 (shēn) — same sound — 深 is shēn; 罙 also sounds out 探 tàn.
